question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Treacherous
solution:
The correct answer is "**Faithful**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given word**:

 
 
• **Treacherous: **guilty of or involving betrayal or deception.
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given words**:
 
 
• ​**Fantastic**: of extraordinary size or degree.
 
• **Flexible**: capable of bending easily without breaking.
 
• **Fluent**: able to express oneself easily and articulately.
 
• **Faithful**: remaining loyal and steadfast.
 
 
 
• ​As per the **meaning** of the given words, "**Faithful**" is the appropriate antonym for the word "**treacherous**".
 
 
• ​**Example**: *Arjun was **faithful **__to his wife so he chose not to remarry after his wife's death.*
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
